prediction_set.statement: Monotone availability: any fixed structure, once realized, remains; availability nondecreasing in process time.
Inclusion decay: a fixed structure available at universe size D is realized with probability <= phi ~ 1/(D-1); earlier-available structures realize with higher probability bound.
Freeze order: lower grades freeze before higher grades; P(a grade's realized set still changes after a given process time) decreases with the grade's availability size.

Configuration ordering: structures requiring k same-step co-served tokens are reachable only for Gamma >= k; families ordered by minimal configuration become reachable in that order as capacity rises; above-threshold families never appear at fixed Gamma.

prediction_set.class: THEOREM; testable against H2 only if it reports multiple independent substrates at equal age, else N/A
prediction_set.statement: Frozen-random subset: independent realizations at equal parameters realize different eventual supports; presence of late-available structures varies across runs.
Cost-ordered persistence: larger chain-multiplicity structures impose larger rendering cost when built upon and are, per unit availability, realized later.

protocol.compared: only H2 patterns invariant under monotone reparametrization of rounds - orderings of family emergence, monotonicity of availability, freezing/saturation, dependence on substrate capacity or family complexity, cross-substrate variability if reported - against P1-P6 and O1-O9, mapped BY DEFINITION at opening (names, words, counts are not maps); 'strain'/'channel' map only if their extracted definitions coincide with a frozen function on z+, else UNMAPPED_COMPUTABLE/UNMAPPED_INAPPLICABLE
protocol.forbidden: round-number alignment; rate comparison; any prediction added, criterion moved, or observable renamed after opening; any repair of the tower in the opening round
protocol.model_family_caveat: the H2 engine's opportunity law and substrate (R48 census + sealed repository commit) are stated at opening; mismatches may reflect them
protocol.rule: PASS iff every mapped reparametrization-invariant H2 pattern is consistent with the corresponding THEOREM-grade prediction and none contradicts one; PARTIAL if consistent but a stage-defining H2 observable is unmapped or matches only at READOUT grade; FAIL if a THEOREM-grade prediction is contradicted by a reparametrization-invariant pattern; mismatches at equal prominence
